exposure: Labor induction at 41+3 weeks of gestation
Labor induction at 41+0 weeks of gestation
outcome: Number of full-term pregnancy control consultations
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women with pregnancies exceeding 40 weeks gestation from 2019 and 2021, comparing those induced at 41+3 weeks with those induced at 41+0 weeks.
finding: Induction of labor at 41+0 weeks, compared to 41+3 weeks, increased the overall induction rate but decreased antepartum visits and instrumental deliveries, while maintaining similar rates of cesarean sections and maternal-fetal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: Earlier induction at 41+0 weeks significantly reduced instrumental deliveries and increased the probability of eutocic delivery compared to induction at 41+3 weeks.
gest_age: Pregnancies > 40 weeks; specifically comparing induction at 41+3 weeks vs 41+0 weeks
